name: Florida county record privacy routes
description: Official office routes and supported procedure details for all 67 Florida counties. Empty cells are unresolved in the reviewed sources, not findings that protection is absent.
scope: All 67 Florida counties. Office directories, identified forms and procedures only. Reviewed field gaps remain explicit. No person or parcel search was performed.
update_policy: Quarterly official-source recheck and after procedure changes.

changelog.change: Draft directory and public-records request route audit. No exemption facts approved.
Enriched ten demand-selected counties with official forms, procedural differences, and explicit gaps. All rows remain draft.
Completed the 67-county official-source review. Reconciled ten county guides and 67 unsent count-only request drafts. Unknown details remain blank.
